name: Mothbound
source:
Eli is a teenager trapped in an abusive home. One winter night, he’s thrown out into the streets, alone, freezing, and hopeless.

A glowing moth appears, guiding him toward something strange… and someone dangerous.

This is the start of an unlikely bond with his mysterious neighbor, Dániel, drawing them into a hidden world of nightmares, magic, and impossible choices.

[From [url=https://yolkiegame.itch.io/mothbound]Itch.io[/url]]
